text: 可上九天揽月，可下五洋捉鳖
pinyin: kě shàng jiǔ tiān lǎn yuè, kě xià wǔ yáng zhuō biē
literal: can · ascend · ninth heaven · pluck · moon, can · descend · five oceans · catch · turtle
natural: we can reach up to the moon and down to catch turtles in the deep sea

meaning.en: A bold boast that nothing is beyond reach: one can go up to the heavens and down to the depths of the sea.
meaning.zh: 形容志向远大、本领高强，上天入海都能办到。

equivalents: to reach for the moon and dive for turtles

examples.zh: 航天人立志可上九天揽月，可下五洋捉鳖。
examples.en: Our space and ocean engineers aim to reach the moon and the deep sea alike.

examples.zh: 年轻人有股可上九天揽月，可下五洋捉鳖的豪气。
examples.en: The young people have a spirit that says nothing is out of reach.

origin.source: 毛泽东《水调歌头·重上井冈山》（1965年）

story.en: Mao Zedong wrote this poem in 1965 on revisiting Jinggangshan; the line reads '可上九天揽月，可下五洋捉鳖，谈笑凯歌还'.
story.zh: 毛泽东1965年重上井冈山时作此词，原句为“可上九天揽月，可下五洋捉鳖，谈笑凯歌还”。

usage.en: Often quoted in news about space exploration and deep-sea diving, where 九天揽月 and 五洋捉鳖 are used as a pair. Positive, formal or literary.
usage.zh: 常用于航天、深海探测等报道，“九天揽月”“五洋捉鳖”也常单独成语使用。褒义，书面语。

text: 牢骚太盛防肠断，风物长宜放眼量
pinyin: láo sāo tài shèng fáng cháng duàn, fēng wù cháng yí fàng yǎn liàng
literal: grumbling · too · much · beware · gut · break, scenery · long · should · let go · eye · measure
natural: too much grumbling will break your heart; take the long view of things

meaning.en: Do not wallow in complaints, which harm your health and mood; look at things from a broad, long-term perspective.
meaning.zh: 不要牢骚满腹、自伤身心，看问题要眼光长远、心胸开阔。

examples.zh: 朋友失业后很消沉，我劝他牢骚太盛防肠断，风物长宜放眼量。
examples.en: When my friend lost his job and was down, I told him not to stew in complaints but to take the long view.

examples.zh: 牢骚太盛防肠断，风物长宜放眼量，眼前的挫折算不了什么。
examples.en: Take the long view; this setback is nothing much.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七律·和柳亚子先生》（1949年）

story.en: In 1949 Mao answered a poem by the poet Liu Yazi, who was grumbling about his treatment; Mao advised him to stay calm and look ahead.
story.zh: 1949年柳亚子赋诗抒发牢骚，毛泽东作诗相和，劝他心胸放宽、目光放远。

usage.en: A consoling line, often quoted when someone is grumbling. 放眼量 is usually used on its own as 放眼量/放长眼光. Positive, literary.
usage.zh: 多用来劝慰爱发牢骚的人要想开些、看远些。积极、书面。

pinyin: wèi zhōng huá zhī jué qǐ ér dú shū
literal: for · China · 's · rise · and · study
natural: to study for the rise of China

meaning.en: A famous pledge to study hard so as to help the nation rise and prosper.
meaning.zh: 为了国家的兴盛强大而发奋读书的志向。

equivalents: learning in service of the country

examples.zh: 开学典礼上，校长引用了“为中华之崛起而读书”。
examples.en: At the opening ceremony the head teacher quoted 'study for the rise of China'.

examples.zh: 少年时他就立下为中华之崛起而读书的志向。
examples.en: As a boy he resolved to study for the rise of China.

origin.source: 周恩来少年时的回答（约1911年）

story.en: Asked at his school in Shenyang around 1911 why one should study, the young Zhou Enlai gave this reply, which is widely told as a story of his youth.
story.zh: 周恩来少年在沈阳东关模范学校读书时，回答老师“为什么读书”，说出这句话，广为流传。

usage.en: Used in school education and patriotic writing. Formal, positive.
usage.zh: 常见于学校教育和爱国主义宣传。正式，褒义。

text: 世界是你们的，也是我们的
pinyin: shì jiè shì nǐ men de, yě shì wǒ men de
literal: world · is · you (pl.) · 's, also · is · we · 's
natural: the world is yours, and also ours

meaning.en: Words of encouragement to young people: the future world belongs to them, though the older generation shares in it.
meaning.zh: 寄语青年：世界属于你们，也属于我们这一代人。

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，老教授对学生们说：世界是你们的，也是我们的。
examples.en: At graduation the old professor told the students, 'The world is yours, and ours too.'

examples.zh: 世界是你们的，也是我们的，但归根结底是你们的。
examples.en: The world is yours and ours, but in the end it is yours.

origin.source: 毛泽东在莫斯科会见中国留学生时的讲话（1957年）

story.en: On 17 November 1957 Mao Zedong told Chinese students in Moscow that the world belongs to them, as young people full of vigour, 'like the sun at eight or nine in the morning'.
story.zh: 1957年11月17日，毛泽东在莫斯科接见中国留学生，说：“世界是你们的，也是我们的，但是归根结底是你们的。”

usage.en: The full sentence continues '但是归根结底是你们的'. Often quoted in speeches to youth. Formal.
usage.zh: 原话后面还有“但是归根结底是你们的”。多用于对青年的讲话。正式。

pinyin: shí jiàn chū zhēn zhī
literal: practice · produces · true · knowledge
natural: true knowledge comes from practice

meaning.en: Real understanding comes from doing things, not from theory alone.
meaning.zh: 真正的知识来自实际行动和经验。

examples.zh: 做实验才知道结果，实践出真知嘛。
examples.en: You only know the result by doing the experiment; true knowledge comes from practice.

examples.zh: 实践出真知，光看书学不会游泳。
examples.en: You can't learn to swim by reading; true knowledge comes from practice.

usage.en: Common in education and Party writing, echoing Marxist epistemology (see Mao's essay 《实践论》, 1937). Neutral to formal.
usage.zh: 常见于教育与理论文章，呼应《实践论》的认识论思想。中性偏正式。

pinyin: yī qiè cóng shí jì chū fā
literal: everything · from · reality · set out
natural: start from reality in everything

meaning.en: Base plans and decisions on actual conditions rather than on wishes or fixed ideas.
meaning.zh: 制订计划、处理问题都要以实际情况为依据。

examples.zh: 政策制定必须一切从实际出发。
examples.en: Policies must start from actual conditions.

examples.zh: 他做事一切从实际出发，从不拍脑袋。
examples.en: He always starts from reality and never decides on a whim.

usage.en: A staple of Chinese official and management language; related to 实事求是. Formal.
usage.zh: 官方和管理语言中的常用语，与“实事求是”相近。正式。

pinyin: lǐ lùn lián xì shí jì
literal: theory · connect · reality
natural: link theory with practice

meaning.en: Apply theory to real problems and test it in practice.
meaning.zh: 把理论用到实际工作中，并在实践中检验理论。

examples.zh: 这门课强调理论联系实际。
examples.en: This course stresses linking theory with practice.

examples.zh: 学习要理论联系实际，不能死读书。
examples.en: Study should connect theory with reality, not be rote reading.

usage.en: A principle of the Chinese education system and Party study, often seen in school and training documents. Formal.
usage.zh: 中国教育和党内学习的一项原则，常见于教学和培训文件。正式。

pinyin: jù tǐ wèn tí jù tǐ fēn xī
literal: concrete · problem · concrete · analyse
natural: analyse each concrete problem concretely

meaning.en: Treat each problem according to its particular circumstances instead of applying one formula to all.
meaning.zh: 针对不同问题的具体情况分别分析，不能一概而论。

examples.zh: 两家公司情况不同，要具体问题具体分析。
examples.en: The two firms are different, so each case must be analysed on its own merits.

examples.zh: 别套公式，具体问题具体分析。
examples.en: Don't apply a formula; look at each problem concretely.

usage.en: Drawn from Marxist dialectics (Lenin's 'concrete analysis of concrete conditions'), popularised in China by Mao's 《矛盾论》 (1937). Common in everyday argument too. Neutral to formal.
usage.zh: 源于马克思主义辩证法，列宁讲“对具体情况作具体分析”，经毛泽东《矛盾论》等推广。日常议论中也常用。

text: 没有调查就没有发言权
pinyin: méi yǒu diào chá jiù méi yǒu fā yán quán
literal: no · investigation · then · no · right to speak
natural: without investigation you have no right to speak

meaning.en: You should not comment on a matter before you have looked into it properly.
meaning.zh: 没有深入了解情况，就没有资格对问题发表意见。

equivalents: no right to speak without research
do your homework before you talk

examples.zh: 没有调查就没有发言权，先去现场看看。
examples.en: Without investigation you have no right to speak; go and see the site first.

examples.zh: 他没调查就乱评论，真是没有调查就没有发言权。
examples.en: He commented without looking into it; you really have no right to speak without investigating.

origin.source: 毛泽东《反对本本主义》（1930年）

story.en: In this 1930 essay, written for the Red Army, Mao argued that one must investigate real conditions before making judgements, and that 'no investigation, no right to speak'.
story.zh: 1930年毛泽东在《反对本本主义》中提出，要先做社会调查再下结论，“没有调查，没有发言权”。

usage.en: Often paired with 'no investigation, no right to speak' as a rebuke to armchair critics. Formal to neutral.
usage.zh: 常用来批评不了解情况就乱发表意见的人。

pinyin: bù dǎ wú zhǔn bèi zhī zhàng
literal: not · fight · no · preparation · 's · battle
natural: never fight an unprepared battle

meaning.en: Do not take on a task or contest without having prepared thoroughly.
meaning.zh: 没有做好充分准备，就不要贸然行动。

examples.zh: 谈判前我们做足功课，不打无准备之仗。
examples.en: We did our homework before the negotiation; we never fight an unprepared battle.

examples.zh: 考试要认真复习，不打无准备之仗。
examples.en: Revise properly for the exam and never go in unprepared.

usage.en: A military principle in Mao-era writing (usually paired with 不打无把握之仗), now a business and everyday maxim. Neutral.
usage.zh: 本为军事原则，常与“不打无把握之仗”并用，现已成为商业与日常格言。中性。

text: 战略上藐视敌人，战术上重视敌人
pinyin: zhàn lüè shàng miǎo shì dí rén, zhàn shù shàng zhòng shì dí rén
literal: strategy · on · despise · enemy, tactics · on · take seriously · enemy
natural: despise the enemy strategically, respect him tactically

meaning.en: Be confident about the final outcome, but treat every concrete contest with full seriousness.
meaning.zh: 在总体上要有必胜信心，在具体问题上要谨慎认真对待。

equivalents: confident in the big picture, careful in the details

examples.zh: 球队教练强调战略上藐视敌人，战术上重视敌人。
examples.en: The coach stressed being confident overall but careful in each match.

examples.zh: 面对强敌，要战略上藐视敌人，战术上重视敌人。
examples.en: Against a strong rival, be confident in strategy yet serious in tactics.

origin.source: 毛泽东在莫斯科的讲话（1957年11月）

story.en: In a November 1957 speech in Moscow, Mao said that strategically we must despise all enemies, and tactically take them seriously.
story.zh: 1957年11月毛泽东在莫斯科的讲话中提出：战略上要藐视一切敌人，战术上要重视一切敌人。

usage.en: Mao's formulation, widely used in the late 1950s, now common in sport and business as 'strategic confidence, tactical caution'. Formal.
usage.zh: 毛泽东在20世纪50年代的讲话中常提到，如今常用于体育、商业，表示总体自信而具体谨慎。

pinyin: qiāng gǎn zi lǐ miàn chū zhèng quán
literal: gun · barrel · inside · produces · political power
natural: political power grows out of the barrel of a gun

meaning.en: Political power is won and held through armed force.
meaning.zh: 政权要靠武装力量夺取和保卫。

equivalents: power grows out of the barrel of a gun

examples.zh: 史书记载的改朝换代，常说枪杆子里面出政权。
examples.en: Histories of dynastic change often say that power grows out of the barrel of a gun.

examples.zh: 他引用“枪杆子里面出政权”来分析当年的局势。
examples.en: He quoted 'power comes from the barrel of a gun' to analyse the situation then.

origin.source: 毛泽东《战争和战略问题》（1938年）

story.en: In his November 1938 speech at the Sixth Plenum of the 6th CCP Central Committee, Mao stressed that 'political power grows out of the barrel of a gun' (枪杆子里面出政权).
story.zh: 1938年11月毛泽东在中共六届六中全会上作报告，提出“枪杆子里面出政权”。

usage.en: A historical political maxim, quoted when analysing wars and revolutions. Neutral, formal; used with that historical frame.
usage.zh: 历史上的政治名言，多在分析战争和革命时引用。中性，正式。

pinyin: nóng cūn bāo wéi chéng shì
literal: countryside · surround · cities
natural: surround the cities from the countryside

meaning.en: The Chinese Communists' strategy of building bases in rural areas first and taking the cities later; now also used for any bottom-up strategy.
meaning.zh: 中共革命的道路：先在农村建立根据地，再夺取城市；今也比喻自下而上的策略。

equivalents: encircling the cities from the countryside

examples.zh: 这家电商靠农村包围城市，先占领下沉市场。
examples.en: This e-commerce firm took the lower-tier markets first, encircling the cities from the countryside.

examples.zh: 革命走农村包围城市的道路。
examples.en: The revolution followed the path of surrounding the cities from the countryside.

usage.en: Associated with Mao's strategy of the 1920s-40s. In business writing it often means conquering small towns before big cities. Neutral.
usage.zh: 与毛泽东二十至四十年代的革命战略相联系。商业文章里常指先占小城镇再进大城市。中性。

pinyin: dǎ tǔ háo, fēn tián dì
literal: beat · local tyrant, divide · fields
natural: strike the landlords, divide up the land

meaning.en: A Red Army slogan of the 1920s-30s: seize the property of landlords and distribute the land to poor peasants.
meaning.zh: 土地革命时期的口号：打倒地主，把土地分给贫苦农民。

equivalents: strike the landlords, divide the land

examples.zh: 历史课上讲到苏区时，老师说起“打土豪，分田地”的口号。
examples.en: In history class the teacher mentioned the slogan 'strike the landlords, divide up the land' for the Soviet areas.

examples.zh: 电影里红军喊着打土豪，分田地。
examples.en: In the film the Red Army shouts to strike the landlords and divide the land.

usage.en: A historical slogan of land reform. Today also used jokingly, e.g. 'let's 打土豪' means to treat a rich friend to a meal. Casual.
usage.zh: 土地革命时的口号。今天也常开玩笑，如“打土豪”指让有钱的朋友请客。口语。

pinyin: zài zhàn zhēng zhōng xué xí zhàn zhēng
literal: in · war · within · learn · war
natural: learn war through war

meaning.en: Skills are best learned by doing the real thing and learning from its experience.
meaning.zh: 要在实战中学习，在实践中积累经验。

examples.zh: 新兵上了战场，才懂得在战争中学习战争。
examples.en: Only on the battlefield did the recruits learn war through war.

examples.zh: 创业也是在战争中学习战争，边做边学。
examples.en: Starting a business is likewise learning as you fight.

origin.source: 毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》（1936年）

story.en: In this 1936 work Mao wrote that learning war from war is the main method of mastering it, which is why he stressed experience over books.
story.zh: 1936年毛泽东在该文中指出，从战争中学习战争是学会指挥战争的主要方法。

usage.en: Often applied jokingly to any learn-on-the-job situation. Formal to neutral.
usage.zh: 常被借用来形容边干边学。正式到中性。

text: 从群众中来，到群众中去
pinyin: cóng qún zhòng zhōng lái, dào qún zhòng zhōng qù
literal: from · the masses · within · come, to · the masses · within · go
natural: come from the masses, go to the masses

meaning.en: Gather opinions from ordinary people, turn them into policy, then take the policy back to the people and test it.
meaning.zh: 向群众收集意见，形成方针，再回到群众中去检验推行。

equivalents: listen to the grassroots, then serve the grassroots

examples.zh: 干部要坚持从群众中来，到群众中去。
examples.en: Cadres should keep to the principle of coming from the masses and going to the masses.

examples.zh: 设计产品也要从群众中来，到群众中去。
examples.en: Product design should likewise start from users and return to them.

origin.source: 毛泽东《关于领导方法的若干问题》（1943年）

story.en: In this 1943 text on leadership methods, Mao laid out the cycle: from the masses, concentrate their ideas, and return them to the masses.
story.zh: 1943年毛泽东在此文中提出“从群众中来，到群众中去”的领导方法。

usage.en: The Party's 'mass line' working method. Formal, in political and management writing.
usage.zh: 党的群众路线的工作方法。正式，用于政治与管理文章。

text: 敌进我退，敌驻我扰，敌疲我打，敌退我追
pinyin: dí jìn wǒ tuì, dí zhù wǒ rǎo, dí pí wǒ dǎ, dí tuì wǒ zhuī
literal: enemy · advance · I · retreat, enemy · halt · I · harass, enemy · tired · I · strike, enemy · retreat · I · pursue
natural: when the enemy advances we retreat; when he halts we harass; when he tires we strike; when he retreats we pursue

meaning.en: The sixteen-character guerrilla formula of the Red Army: avoid a stronger enemy, harass him, attack when he is weak, pursue when he retreats.
meaning.zh: 红军游击战术十六字诀：避强击弱，保存自己，消耗敌人。

examples.zh: 历史课本介绍了敌进我退，敌驻我扰，敌疲我打，敌退我追的游击战术。
examples.en: The textbook describes the guerrilla tactic of 'enemy advances, we retreat; enemy halts, we harass; enemy tires, we strike; enemy retreats, we pursue'.

examples.zh: 小公司对大公司，用的就是敌进我退，敌驻我扰，敌疲我打，敌退我追。
examples.en: The small firm treats the giant as the old guerrilla formula says.

usage.en: Formed in the Jinggangshan period (1928) and credited to the Red Army under Mao and Zhu De. Also quoted as a business tactic. Formal.
usage.zh: 红军在井冈山时期（1928年）总结形成，常认为出自毛泽东、朱德领导的红军。也用于商业竞争的比喻。正式。

text: 一切反动派都是纸老虎
pinyin: yī qiè fǎn dòng pài dōu shì zhǐ lǎo hǔ
literal: all · reactionaries · all · are · paper · tiger
natural: all reactionaries are paper tigers

meaning.en: Powerful-looking opponents are actually weak at root and need not be feared.
meaning.zh: 看起来强大的敌人其实本质虚弱，不必害怕。

examples.zh: 他引用一切反动派都是纸老虎来鼓舞士气。
examples.en: He quoted 'all reactionaries are paper tigers' to lift morale.

examples.zh: 历史书里有一章专门分析一切反动派都是纸老虎的论断。
examples.en: One chapter analyses the claim that all reactionaries are paper tigers.

origin.source: 毛泽东《和美国记者安娜·路易斯·斯特朗的谈话》（1946年）

story.en: In an August 1946 interview with the American journalist Anna Louise Strong, Mao said that all reactionaries are paper tigers.
story.zh: 1946年8月毛泽东会见美国记者斯特朗时说：“一切反动派都是纸老虎。”

usage.en: The English term 'paper tiger' spread from this remark. Today 纸老虎 alone is the common word. Formal and historical.
usage.zh: 英语“paper tiger”由此广泛传开。如今多单用“纸老虎”。正式，带历史色彩。

pinyin: yǔ tiān fèn dòu, qí lè wú qióng
literal: with · heaven · struggle, its · joy · no · end
natural: struggling with heaven brings endless joy

meaning.en: To struggle against nature and difficulty is a source of endless pleasure.
meaning.zh: 与自然和困难搏斗，乐趣无穷。

equivalents: there is joy in the struggle

examples.zh: 登山队的口号是“与天奋斗，其乐无穷”。
examples.en: The mountaineering team's motto was 'there is endless joy in struggling with heaven'.

examples.zh: 治水的人说，与天奋斗，其乐无穷。
examples.en: The flood-control workers said there is endless joy in struggling with nature.

origin.source: 毛泽东《〈伦理学原理〉批注》（1917年）

story.en: The young Mao annotated a translation of Friedrich Paulsen's A System of Ethics around 1917 and wrote that to struggle with heaven, earth and men is endless joy.
story.zh: 青年毛泽东约1917年批注泡尔生《伦理学原理》时写下：与天奋斗，其乐无穷；与地奋斗，其乐无穷；与人奋斗，其乐无穷。

usage.en: Often paired with 与地奋斗，其乐无穷；与人奋斗，其乐无穷. Used in Mao-era slogans on conquering nature; today seen as a motto of perseverance. Formal.
usage.zh: 常与“与地奋斗，其乐无穷；与人奋斗，其乐无穷”连用。多用于激励拼搏。正式。

text: 人有多大胆，地有多大产
pinyin: rén yǒu duō dà dǎn, dì yǒu duō dà chǎn
literal: man · has · how big · nerve, land · has · how big · yield
natural: the bolder the people, the bigger the harvest

meaning.en: A Great Leap Forward slogan claiming that boldness alone could raise farm output; now cited as a warning about wishful thinking and false reporting.
meaning.zh: 大跃进时期的口号，宣称只要胆子大产量就能提高；今多作为不顾实际、虚报浮夸的反面例子。

equivalents: boldness as a substitute for facts

examples.zh: 经济课上，老师用“人有多大胆，地有多大产”分析浮夸风。
examples.en: In economics class the teacher used 'the bolder the people, the bigger the harvest' to discuss exaggeration.

examples.zh: 人有多大胆，地有多大产，只是个历史教训。
examples.en: 'The bolder the people, the bigger the harvest' is now just a lesson of history.

usage.en: A 1958 slogan of the Great Leap Forward (the grain claims of the time were wildly inflated). Now used critically or ironically. Casual.
usage.zh: 1958年大跃进的口号（当时粮食产量多有浮夸）。今多带批评或讽刺意味。口语。

pinyin: gǔ zú gàn jìn, lì zhēng shàng yóu
literal: pump up · full · drive, strive · for · upper · stream
natural: muster all your energy and strive to be first

meaning.en: Work with full energy and aim to be among the best.
meaning.zh: 干劲十足，努力争当先进。

equivalents: go all out and aim high

examples.zh: 新学期开始了，大家要鼓足干劲，力争上游。
examples.en: A new term has begun; everyone should muster all their energy and strive to be at the top.

examples.zh: 工厂的墙上写着“鼓足干劲，力争上游”。
examples.en: The factory wall bears the slogan 'muster all your energy and strive to be first'.

story.en: At its 1958 Party congress session, the CCP adopted the general line 'go all out, aim high, build socialism faster, better and more economically' (多快好省).
story.zh: 1958年中共八大二次会议通过的总路线：“鼓足干劲，力争上游，多快好省地建设社会主义”。

usage.en: Part of the 1958 'general line' for socialist construction: 鼓足干劲，力争上游，多快好省地建设社会主义. Now a general motivational phrase. Formal.
usage.zh: 1958年社会主义建设总路线的前半部分：“鼓足干劲，力争上游，多快好省地建设社会主义”。如今泛用作激励语。正式。
